_meta.session: Push #24 — HCI-ULTRASOUND canonical sibling created (doctrine-only scaffold). Direct extension of the DADC compositional principle into active sensing for medical and industrial non-contact ultrasound, with geometry lock probe as headline use case.
_meta.purpose: Canonical home for non-contact ultrasound work in the Hs system. Sibling of HCI-CNT, HCI-CNQ, and HCI-AUDIO.

tier.name: HCI-ULTRASOUND
next_milestones: First pilot on a public ultrasound dataset

options: frequency bands of the return signal (broadband)
carriers.joint_quaternion_lift: amplitude + phase (time-of-flight) per channel/frequency lifted to unit quaternion via standard CNQ procedure
carriers.primary_diagnostic: Joint Helmsman + Helmsman Stability (proposed extensions, see HCI-CNT/handbook/GLOSSARY.md §I)

lineage.origin: DADC (Dimension-Apportioned Diffraction Correction) at Binaural Test Lab, Markham (Rogue-Wave-Audio repository)
lineage.fixed_total_old: 6.02 dB diffraction budget on cabinet dimensions (passive correction)
lineage.fixed_total_new: total return-signal energy and phase information at the probe (active sensing)
lineage.new_ingredient: active control loop: system steers to maintain helmsman lock on target geometry
